categoryDefinitions.description: Card text mentions gaining or taking cards.
Gain destination may be deck or top of deck.
Card text mentions the discard pile, often as a gain destination or source.
Card text can move cards to trash.
Card text can return owned cards to a supply or non-owned pile.
Card text can move cards to or from exile.
Reserve card or tavern mat behavior can keep cards across turns outside normal play/discard zones.
Duration or next-turn behavior can keep cards in play across cleanup.
patterns: \bat the start of your next turn\b

categoryDefinitions.description: Card text can set cards aside into temporary hidden or visible zones.
Card text exchanges one card-shaped object for another.
Card text can reveal or inspect cards, improving location knowledge.
Card text mentions deck or shuffle behavior that can affect hidden ordering knowledge.
Card text mentions a named Dominion zone that may matter for location tracking.

gain.description: Card text mentions gaining or taking cards.

gain-to-deck.description: Gain destination may be deck or top of deck.

gain-to-discard.description: Card text mentions the discard pile, often as a gain destination or source.

trash.description: Card text can move cards to trash.

return-to-supply-or-pile.description: Card text can return owned cards to a supply or non-owned pile.

exile.description: Card text can move cards to or from exile.

tavern-reserve.description: Reserve card or tavern mat behavior can keep cards across turns outside normal play/discard zones.

duration-or-next-turn.description: Duration or next-turn behavior can keep cards in play across cleanup.
patterns: \bat the start of your next turn\b

set-aside.description: Card text can set cards aside into temporary hidden or visible zones.

exchange.description: Card text exchanges one card-shaped object for another.

reveal.description: Card text can reveal or inspect cards, improving location knowledge.

shuffle-deck.description: Card text mentions deck or shuffle behavior that can affect hidden ordering knowledge.

named-zone.description: Card text mentions a named Dominion zone that may matter for location tracking.

behaviorReview.reviewBasis: Codex read the normalized text for each tracker candidate and encoded the resulting judgment as reason definitions plus per-card priority records.

priorityDefinitions.must-check: Likely to require explicit in-game behavior checks for ownership, location, or knowledge tracking.
priorityDefinitions.watch: Worth awareness, but probably handled by generic move/snapshot logic unless testing proves otherwise.
priorityDefinitions.normal: No tracker-specific behavior found beyond ordinary draw/economy or generic movement.

reasonDefinitions.description: Can return or exchange owned cards, so ownership ledgers may need card-specific verification.
Can trash owned cards; generic movement handling should cover this, but ownership loss should be regression-tested.
Uses exile, which is a persistent non-deck/non-discard player zone.
Uses the tavern mat or Reserve calling flow, which can hold cards outside normal cleanup.
Sets cards aside into a temporary or persistent nonstandard zone.
Uses a named player mat other than the normal deck, hand, discard, play, trash, exile, or tavern zones.
Can keep cards in play or otherwise defer state changes across turns; likely generic, but turn-boundary behavior needs coverage.
Can gain cards somewhere other than the default discard pile.
patterns: \bgain[^.]*\b(?:onto|on top of|to the top of) your deck\b

reasonDefinitions.description: Can put cards onto the deck, reorder cards, or otherwise alter hidden deck order.
patterns: \bshuffle your discard pile into your deck\b

reasonDefinitions.description: Looks through, searches, reveals, or inspects hidden deck cards.
Can play cards from deck, discard, trash, Supply, Black Market deck, or other non-hand/unowned sources.
patterns: \bplay (?:a|an|any|the|that|this|it|up to|[0-9]+|\d+)[^.]*\bfrom (?:your deck|your discard pile|it|the trash|the Supply|them)\b
\bfrom your deck as if in your hand\b
\bplay it at the start of your next turn\b

reasonDefinitions.description: Can gain a card and play it immediately or later without first going through the ordinary discard flow.
patterns: \bgain [^.]+\. Return to your Action phase and play it\b

reasonDefinitions.description: Looks through or moves cards out of discard, which affects reshuffle/location knowledge.
Moves cards from hand to discard/deck/play in ways that may need knowledge-state checks.
Reveals or looks at cards without necessarily moving them, which can improve certainty.
Attack may move or reveal opponents' cards, so opponent knowledge handling should be checked.
Possession-like control changes whose cards are visible, gained, trashed, or set aside.
Can transfer an owned card directly between players.
